subject: AWS Marketplace: production hooks, contract dependencies, and final activation checklist
messages:
From: Andrew Smith <andrew.smith@acme-analytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: acme-legal@acme-analytics.com
Date: 2027-04-12T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft SaaS addendum + AWS activation timeline

Kimberly,

Thanks for the updated addendum. Legal flagged two integration items that we need to confirm before signing: (1) the entitlement activation path for our SSO users (we use email as the canonical identifier) and (2) invoicing cadence when usage spans billing cycles (we do monthly budgets).

On the technical side our infra lead wants the exact product code and sample fulfillment payload so they can test in our AWS sandbox account (aws-sbx-acme-01). Could you also confirm the expected idempotency behavior of the metering webhook?

Targets: we want to be live on AWS Marketplace by 2027-05-05. If there are contract items that will block that, please highlight them.

— Andrew
Head of Procurement, Acme Analytics
acme-analytics.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Andrew Smith <andrew.smith@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-13T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft SaaS addendum + AWS activation timeline

Andrew — thanks, all good questions. Quick answers inline then an ask for a short integration plan: 

1) Entitlement identifier: We support both email and a customer-managed account_id. For Marketplace fulfillment we map the AWS CustomerIdentifier to your canonical email by default unless you prefer account_id. We'll include the mapping in the fulfillment/activate webhook response.

2) Invoicing/proration: Marketplace invoices on AWS side follow monthly cycles. For metered usage we recommend emitting usage records hourly and relying on our reconciliation job for any mid-cycle corrections; we will surface adjustments in the invoice notes and provide a csv reconciliation. The addendum has language for "billing adjustments" — I'll pull the exact clause for you.

3) Product code & payload: Product code for testing: prd-0acme-9f2b. Sample fulfillment payload and the metering webhook spec attached (metering_webhook_spec_v3.xlsx). Idempotency: our endpoint requires an Idempotency-Key header. Metering events include a usageRecordId; duplicates are ignored if the Idempotency-Key or usageRecordId matches an already-processed entry.

We have an internal pre-prod plan that we can run with your infra team this week. Can you nominate 1 engineer and an availability window? If you sign the addendum by Tuesday (DocuSign link below), we can start onboarding Thursday and hit the 5/5 target.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/456782

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.com <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, andrew.smith@acme-analytics.com
Date: 2027-04-16T08:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft SaaS addendum + AWS activation timeline

Kimberly / team — operational checklist and a couple of gotchas from infra: 

- Fulfillment endpoint: we expect a POST to /marketplace/fulfillment/activate with body { productCode, customerIdentifier, entitlementPlanId, effectiveDate } and we return { entitlementId, externalAccountId }. Ensure the payload includes email or account_id.
- Metering: call the AWS Metering Service using RegisterUsage with dimension "tokens". Use our client library which retries with exponential backoff and sets Idempotency-Key = sha256(timestamp + externalAccountId + nonce).
- Test accounts: use aws-sbx-acme-01 (AWS account ID 111122223333) and the product code prd-0acme-9f2b. We will provide temporary API keys for the staging metering endpoint.
- Reconciliation: our reconciliation job runs daily and writes a delta csv to the shared Drive folder; legal will need that for invoices > $10k.

Gotcha: when customers switch plans mid-cycle we create a prorated entitlement delta that is sent as a separate usage record; make sure Acme's billing system can accept negative adjustments.

Next steps: confirm engineer for onboarding + sign addendum. I'm available Wed/Thu mornings PST for a 30m call to walk through the webhook payloads.

— Ben
Senior Product Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: andrew.smith@acme-analytics.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, acme-legal@acme-analytics.com, aws-marketplace-integration@amazon.com
Date: 2027-04-20T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: AWS Marketplace activation: final checklist and DocuSign completed

Andrew — quick update and final checklist now that we have the signed addendum attached.

Status: DocuSign received this morning (signed copy attached: acme_saas_addendum_signed.pdf). AWS Marketplace has been notified and AWS Marketplace Support (cc'ed) confirmed they can provision the SaaS listing as soon as we complete two quick items below.

Final activation checklist: 
1) Redirection/fulfillment endpoint reachable from AWS (please confirm your infra allows AWS IP ranges).
2) Mapping choice: you confirmed email as canonical identifier — Ben will provide the mapping table for your engineers to validate.
3) Staging test run: we scheduled a test metering run on 2027-04-22 09:00 PST using aws-sbx-acme-01 and product code prd-0acme-9f2b. Ben will share staging API keys prior to the window.
4) Invoicing note: we'll add the reconciliation csv to the shared Drive daily; accounting at Acme will get a weekly exported CSV.
5) Final sign-off: we need a short readiness email from Acme infra after the staging run.

Attachments: acme_saas_addendum_signed.pdf, metering_webhook_spec_v3.xlsx

If the staging run passes, AWS will flip the listing to active within 24 hours and your customers will start seeing the listing on Marketplace. Can you reply with the engineer who will run the staging test and the time-zone they prefer?

Thanks everyone — this is the last mile. Happy to hop on a call if helpful.

— Kimberly Park
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
